title: Terms of Payment and Hand-back, Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services
content:
# Terms of Payment and Hand-back

1. The fee for an engagement under Belrose Appraisal and Gemological Services falls due at the stage the service sets, and at the services that take a deposit the deposit is that share of the quoted fee taken when the piece is brought in. The stage at which the fee falls due and the deposit share are fixed per service.
2. A payment is taken against an engagement only while it stands at item received, in examination, report drafted, issued or delivered. The stage is read from the engagement record under its appraisal reference, and that record governs.
3. The report is handed over only once the balance has reached zero, and identification is checked before the piece and the report are handed back. The balance on an engagement is what the customer owes for it: increased by each priced fee and decreased by payments and credits.

## Stage at which a payment is taken

| Engagement stands at | Payment taken |
|---|---|
| Requested | No |
| Item received | Yes |
| In examination | Yes |
| Report drafted | Yes |
| Issued | Yes |
| Delivered | Yes |
| Expired | No |
| Cancelled | No |

## The deposit, on hypothetical figures

An engagement is quoted at a hypothetical 800 under a service whose deposit is 25 per cent of the quoted fee. The deposit taken when the piece is brought in is 25 per cent of 800, which is 200. Under a service that takes no deposit, nothing is taken at intake on that account, and the fee falls due at the stage the service sets.

## Points answered

**The engagement stands at issued and a balance remains. Is the report handed over?** No. The report is handed over only once the balance has reached zero.

**The customer wishes to pay while the engagement still stands at requested.** A payment is not taken at that stage; it is taken once the engagement stands at item received or later, up to and including delivered.

**Is identification checked even where the balance is already zero?** Yes. Identification is checked before the piece and the report are handed back, whatever the balance.
